
### going faster 


* so far: send one message, wait for acknowledgment 
<hr class="vspace" />
* very slow!
* instead, can send a bunch of parts and get them acknowledged together


### transmission window (ex: size 4) 

![](/network/texfig/split-faster-transmission-window-ex-size-4.figure.svg){width=900px fig-alt="machine A sends part 1, part 2, part 3, part 4 to machine B without waiting for responses. Machine B sends an ACK for each of them."}

Send a <i>window</i> of parts speculatively, then wait for ACKs.
